headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule applies. Use Clash Display for an impactful, high-end editorial future look. Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for H1-H3.

body.strategy: Geometric Body for high readability on data-heavy dashboards and long text.

colors.strategy: Deep void black base for immersion. Vivid cyan and hot pink accents for VEDED (AI Creation) and Crimson Red for BOOKSTREAM (OTT).

surfaces.name: The Tracing Beam (Neon Active)
surfaces.usage: Active generation cards, Premium tier pricing cards
surfaces.classes: relative overflow-hidden border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-500/50 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.15)] transition-all duration-300

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Sections use py-20 or py-32.

grids.landing_page: Split screen or Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
grids.veded_dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Sidebars for prompts (col-span-1), Canvas for generation (col-span-3).
grids.bookstream_browse: Horizontal scrollable lanes (flex-row overflow-x-auto snap-x) with massive cards for featured content.

layouts.alignment: Left-align form inputs and dense content. Center-align hero content only if symmetrically balanced.

components.navigation: Unified glassmorphic header with an App Switcher dropdown (VEDED <-> BOOKSTREAM) and shared credit wallet balance.
components.cards: Flat, sharp or max 8px border-radius. No muddy shadows. Use subtle 1px border. Dark gray background.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md). High contrast focus states. VEDED uses Cyan bg with black text. BOOKSTREAM uses Red bg with white text.
components.media_player: Edge-to-edge cinematic container. Custom controls overlay using Shadcn Slider.
components.forms: Use Shadcn inputs, selects. Left aligned labels, uppercase overlines.

motion.hover: Explicit hover states: hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white. Hover cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. transition-transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO transition-all.
motion.animations: Micro-interactions on AI generation (pulse, glowing borders). Smooth entrance for content grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for text. Use text shadow over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: High contrast focus rings. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:ring-offset-black.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Implement a unified auth system and dashboard, but visually distinguish VEDED (Cyan/Pink tech vibe) and BOOKSTREAM (Red/Gold cinematic vibe).
The shared header MUST have a Glassmorphism effect and cannot be purely transparent. Include a clear toggle or dropdown to switch between VEDED and BOOKSTREAM.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the marketing landing page layouts to allow overlapping and asymmetry. Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, tabs, and dashboards.
Ensure the VEDED creation tools use a dense grid layout (Grid Mode B) with the prompt inputs on the left and the generation canvas/gallery on the right.
Ensure BOOKSTREAM uses large horizontal carousels for browsing movies/audiobooks with dark cinematic overlays.
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image services.
universal_guidelines: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
NEVER apply 'transition: all'. Use specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
DO NOT use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
